opportunities.title: APEX Awards
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established independent researchers based at a UK university or UK not‑for‑profit research organisation, with a permanent or fixed‑term position covering the award duration.
opportunities.summary: Interdisciplinary, curiosity‑driven research across humanities, social sciences, engineering and natural sciences, with up to £200,000 funding for up to 24 months.

opportunities.title: SHAPE Involve and Engage
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Any researcher based in the UK, across all career stages, working on a public‑engagement project with a GLAM or performing‑arts partner.
opportunities.summary: Funding for innovative public‑engagement projects in the humanities and social sciences, up to £8,000 for projects running April 2027–December 2028.

opportunities.title: Talent Development Awards 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based postdoctoral researchers (or above) with a long‑term appointment at a UK university or research institute, working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Supports skill‑development and methodological innovation for UK researchers, up to £10,000 for 6–12 months.

opportunities.title: International Interdisciplinary Research Projects 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based principal investigators in the humanities or social sciences, with international co‑applicants, leading interdisciplinary projects on mobilities.
opportunities.summary: Funding for UK‑led interdisciplinary projects with international partners, up to £300,000 (80 % FEC) for 24 months starting March/April 2027.

opportunities.title: Global Innovation Fellowships: The German Council on Foreign Relations (DGAP) 2026-27
opportunities.eligibility_summary: UK‑based early‑ or mid‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences; fellowship hosted at DGAP in Berlin with required overseas co‑applicants.
opportunities.summary: One‑year fellowships to develop policy‑relevant research and networks, up to £150,000 (80 % FEC).

opportunities.title: The Alexander von Humboldt Foundation and The British Academy Knowledge Frontiers Symposium 2027
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers based at UK or German institutions, working in the humanities or social sciences.
opportunities.summary: Attendance at a three‑day interdisciplinary symposium on ‘Humans and Nature’, with seed funding for collaborative projects.

opportunities.title: Additional Needs Funding
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Current British Academy award‑holders or applicants planning to apply for a British Academy award within the next six months.
opportunities.summary: One‑off support for specific additional needs (e.g., equipment, caring costs, accessibility support) up to £4,000.

opportunities.title: Postdoctoral Fellowships
opportunities.eligibility_summary: Early‑career researchers in the humanities or social sciences, based at a UK university or research organisation, with a doctorate awarded between 1 Apr 2024 and 1 Apr 2027.
opportunities.summary: Three‑year fellowships (80 % salary funded) for independent research, commencing Autumn 2027.
